programme.sub-title: Save the Bat!/Save the Acting Donkey!

programme.title: Wonder Pets
programme.desc: In this film noir episode, narrated by Linny, the Wonder Pets must help a Fox whose diamond-studded collar has mysteriously disappeared.
programme.sub-title: Save the Vixen!/Teach an Old Dog New Tricks!

programme.title: Wonder Pets
programme.desc: When Aunt Eleanora asks Ming-Ming to watch little Marvin, Ming-Ming brings the whole team to KalamaZoo! When Bee and Slug decide to explore what life is like underground, they get stuck in some ooey gooey mud.
programme.sub-title: Back to Kalamazoo!/Bee and Slug Underground!

programme.title: Wonder Pets
programme.desc: Ming-Ming flies through the shrink machine the wrong way and becomes enormous! In this swinging Andrews Sisters-style show, the Wonder Pets get a phone call from Little Bo Peep, who's lost her three singing Sheep.
programme.sub-title: The Bigger the Better!/Help Little Bo Peep!

programme.title: Wonder Pets
programme.desc: The Wonder Pets travel to Cape Cod to help a Lobster in a lobster trap free himself before the trap is raised. Floppy the Elephant comes to the classroom for a sleepover. But when Floppy gets homesick, the team must help him feel at home.
programme.sub-title: Save the Rock Lobster!/Help the Houseguest!

programme.title: Wonder Pets
programme.desc: The Wonder Pets travel to the Florida Everglades to reunite a pair of quarreling Lovebugs on Valentine's Day./The Wonder Pets get a call from Manchester, England where a Skunk Rocker can't find a band to play with him.
programme.sub-title: Save the Lovebugs!/Save the Skunk Rocker!

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Ni Hao, Halloween: Trick or treat, it's Halloween! Kai-lan and her friends dress up to go trick or treating with Ye-Ye. Kai-lan is a dinosaur, Tolee's a panda, Hoho's the Monkey King, and Rintoo is his favorite – a dragon!

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Beach Day: Kai-lan is excited because today she's going to the beach with Ye-Ye and her friends, to play in the sand, fly kites, and go in the water!

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Roller Rintoo: Kai-lan and her friends are off to a roller rink to go skating! But when Rintoo won't put on his roller skates, Kai-lan thinks something is wrong. It turns out that Rintoo is scared of roller skating.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Rain or Shine: Kai-lan and her friends are planning a big day of playing outdoors, when suddenly it starts to rain! Kai-lan happily finds a way to play in the rain, but Rintoo, Tolee and Hoho are very upset because of the rain.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Ni Hao Kai-lan: Kai-lan and her friends wake up early today because...there's a CARNIVAL in the backyard with game booths, prizes and rides!

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Lulu Day: Today, Kai-lan is having a playdate with her best girl friend, Lu-lu the rhino! Kai-lan is ready with all sorts of games and things to play with Lu-lu. But Lu-lu wants to play with DIFFERENT things than Kai-lan.

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Sports Day: Kai-lan LOVES dinosaurs, and today she's made up a whole bunch of Olympic-style Dinosaur Games to play with her friends!

programme.title: Ni Hao, Kai-lan CA
programme.desc: Kai-lan gets a phone call from her favorite great aunt , Gu-nai-nai, in China, inviting us to come to China and meet a baby panda! Ye-Ye, Kai-lan, and her friends take an airplane to China to meet the baby.

programme.title: South Park: L'Eté, Ca Craint
programme.desc: Alors que Jimbo et Ned veulent faire des feux d'artifice pour le 4 juillet, M. Garrison s'aperçoit que M. Toc a disparu et qu'il est 'son côté gay'.

programme.title: South Park: Les Boulettes du Chef au Chocolat Salé
programme.desc: Le festival de Sundance arrive à South Park. Mais les festivaliers étouffent M. Hankey avec leurs déjections pleines de nourriture bio.
programme.sub-title: Les Boulettes du Chef au Chocolat Salé

programme.title: South Park: La Varicelle
programme.desc: Les parents de South Park décident de donner la varicelle à leurs enfants pour éviter qu'ils ne l'attrapent vieux.

programme.title: South Park: Roger Ebert Devrait Manger moins de Gras
programme.desc: La classe de Mr. Garrison est emmenée au planétarium de South Park, qui est un lieu des plus ennuyeux.
programme.sub-title: Roger Ebert Devrait Manger moins de Gras

programme.title: South Park: La Garçonnière
programme.desc: Alors que Stan doit construire une garçonnière pour jouer à 'action ou vérité' avec Wendy, ses parents se séparent.

programme.title: South Park: Les Journées Vaches
programme.desc: C'est la fête de la vache à South Park. La programmation inclut rodéo et fête foraine.

programme.title: South Park: Chef Aid
programme.desc: Chef a été spolié: on lui a volé des droits sur ses chansons.

programme.title: South Park: Poisson Sanglant
programme.desc: Tante Flo, la sœur de Sharon Marsh, offre à son neveu un poisson rouge. Mais Stan découvre que c'est en réalité un serial killer.

programme.title: South Park: Joyeux Noël Charlie Manson
programme.desc: Kyle, Kenny et Cartman s'en vont pour les fêtes de Noël dans le Nebraska pour aller rendre visite à la grand-mère de Cartman.

programme.title: South Park: Gnomes
programme.desc: Mr. Tweek risque de perdre son café à cause de la concurrence des cafés Harbucks.

programme.title: South Park: Tropicale, Schtropicale
programme.desc: Les garçons sont envoyés dans la forêt tropicale du Costa Rica avec les enfants de la chorale.

programme.title: South Park: Combustion Spontanée
programme.desc: Les citoyens de South Park prennent feu sans explication. Trouvera-t-on la cause de ces combustions spontanées?

programme.title: South Park: La Maman de Chef
programme.desc: Depuis que Chef a rencontré la fille de ses rêves, les garçons se sentent delaissés.

programme.title: South Park: Tweek contre Craig
programme.desc: Les garçons forcent leurs réticents camarades de classe, Tweek et Craig à se battre.

programme.title: South Park: Les Jakovasaures
programme.desc: Cartman découvre un Jakovasaure femelle, puis un mâle.

programme.title: South Park: Le Panda du Harcèlement Sexuel
programme.desc: Un panda, venu dans la classe de Stan et de ses amis expliquer le principe du harcèlement sexuel et encourager sa dénonciation, déclenche une folie du procès à South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Orgie de Chat
programme.desc: Mme Cartman va à la fête donnée chez M. Mackey et laisse son fils sous la garde de Shelly Marsh.

programme.title: South Park: Deux Hommes tout Nus dans un Jacuzzi
programme.desc: Après avoir laissé Shelley chez les Cartman, la famille Marsh se rend chez M. Mackey, et Stan est relégué à la cave avec d'autres enfants pas très fréquentables. Pendant ce temps, les papas de South Park expérimentent le jacuzzi.
programme.sub-title: Deux Hommes tout Nus dans un Jacuzzi

programme.title: South Park: Les Scouts juifs
programme.desc: Pendant que leurs parents sont à la fêtes, Kyle, Ike et Kenny sont à une fête religieuse juif. Ils se rendent compte rapidement que cette cérémonie sera propice à un complot.

programme.title: South Park: Chinpokomon
programme.desc: Les enfants sont pris dans la folie Chinpokomon qui est en fait une conspiration anti-americaine de nostalgiques de Pearl Harbor.

programme.title: South Park: Ethernopien dans l'Espace
programme.desc: Pascal la Dalle cherche où reloger son village pour qu'ils échappent aux missionnaires chrétiens.

programme.title: South Park: Korn et le Mystère Mystérieux
programme.desc: À l'approche d'Halloween, South Park est en effervescence, sauf le père Maxi qui considère cette fête comme une vénération de Satan.

programme.title: South Park: Les Comptines du Singe Batteur
programme.desc: Un concours d'orthographe a lieu à South Park. Deux enfants qui sont scolarisés à domicile remportent le trophée alors que Cartman avait une arme secrète : les comptines du singe batteur.

programme.title: South Park: Médaille de Connerie avec Palme
programme.desc: Une reconstitution de la bataille de la guerre de Sécession, opposant les Nordistes aux Sudistes, est organisée à South Park.

programme.title: South Park: Les Chants de Noël de M.Hankey
programme.desc: Mr Hankey nous présente ses meilleurs vœux sous forme de showcase musical où tout le monde participe.
programme.sub-title: Les Chants de Noël de M.Hankey

programme.title: South Park: Dieu es-tu là ? C'est Jésus à l'appareil
programme.desc: Le monde se prépare à passer à l'an 2000, à South Park, on s'attend à ce que Jésus fasse venir Dieu sur Terre pour le millénium.
programme.sub-title: Dieu es-tu là ? C'est Jésus à l'appareil

programme.title: South Park: Le Bruit Marron
programme.desc: Un énorme concert de flûtes à bec dirigé par Yoko Ono et réunissant les enfants de tous les États-Unis doit se dérouler dans l'Arkansas.

programme.title: South Park: Inqualifiable crime de haine
programme.desc: Les filles défient les garçons à la luge. Les garçons acceptent, certains de gagner grâce au cul de Cartman.

programme.title: South Park: La Petite Fée des Dents
programme.desc: Cartman se réveille et découvre que la fée des dents lui a apporté 2 dollars pour sa dent de lait. Il décide alors de chercher plein de dents pour s'acheter une console.

programme.title: South Park: Quintuple contorsionniste
programme.desc: Le cirque vient d'arriver à South Park. Le numéro des Quintuplés contorsionnistes donne envie aux enfants de faire un numéro.

programme.title: South Park: Timmy 2000
programme.desc: Lors de l'interro de début de cours, Timmy, un nouvel élève handicapé ne sait pas répondre. Il est alors envoyé chez la principale. Les médecins lui diagnostiquent un déficit aigu de l'attention, qui le prive de devoirs.

programme.title: South Park: Pip!
programme.desc: Cet épisode spécial est consacré à Pip, personnage très spécial inspiré d'un roman de Charles Dickens intitulé 'Les Grandes Espérances'. Pip est un jeune forgeron et va devoir trouver une solution pour conquérir le cœur de la belle Estella.

programme.title: South Park: Cartman adhère à la Nambla
programme.desc: Cartman en a marre des autres. Pour lui ils ne sont pas assez matures. Il décide de trouver des amis adultes sur Internet, mais tous ses amis se font envoyer en prison. Il va voir Mephesto pour avoir un ami artificiel.

programme.title: South Park: Tampons en Cheveux de Cherok
programme.desc: Kyle tombe gravement malade, et en ville tout le monde ne jure que par la médecine à base de plantes des indiens. La mère de Kyle refuse alors de faire hospitaliser son fils croyant qu'il ira mieux avec les plantes.

programme.title: South Park: Chef Pète les Plombs
programme.desc: Chef est scandalisé : le drapeau de South Park est selon lui raciste. Afin d'en juger avec la plus grande impartialité, il est demandé aux enfants de décider s'il faut changer ou non le drapeau.

programme.title: South Park: Un Truc Qu'on Peut Faire Avec le Doigt
programme.desc: Cartman décide de mettre à exécution le rêve qu'il vient de faire : monter un groupe de musique avec les autres garçons pour gagner '10 millions de dollars'.
programme.sub-title: Un Truc Qu'on Peut Faire Avec le Doigt

programme.title: South Park: Les handicapés vont-ils en enfer?
programme.desc: Le Pasteur décide de parler de l'enfer. Il fait alors peur aux enfants en leur disant que s'ils ne sont pas de bons chrétiens, ils périront dans les flammes de l'enfer. Les enfants, décident alors de devenir de bons chrétiens.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja

programme.sub-title: Voyage au centre de l'esprit de Mikey

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja

programme.desc: Alors que les tortues s'apprêtent à partir chercher le dernier morceau du générateur de trou noir, elles sont happées dans un univers parallèle, celui des tortues ninja du dessin animé de 1987.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Les tortues captent un signal de détresse. C'est Mona, qui leur apprend que son commandant Sal a été capturé par Armaggon sur l'ordre de Dregg.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja
programme.desc: Le compte à rebours est lancé avant la mise en route du générateur de trou noir par les Tricératons pour aspirer la planète Terre. Il reste peu de temps aux tortues pour empêcher ces derniers de réduire la planète à néant.

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja

programme.sub-title: Tokka contre le reste du monde

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja

programme.title: Les Tortues Ninja

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: The Decepticons lose another battle: Megatron takes out his frustration on Starscream, beating him half to death for no reason. Sideways uses the situation to try to foment unrest and rebellion.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Trapped in cyberspace with Sideways, Alexis, Rad, Carlos and their minicons become aware of a massive evil entity, far more powerful and dangerous than Megatron, lurking threateningly in the background. Or was it all a dream?

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: A new transformer enters the solar system. On the moon, Thrust the master tactician arrives to assist Megatron in his battle against the Autobots, but all does not go according to plan.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: With Optimus damaged and temporarily out of commission, the newly-arrived Jetfire takes command - and seriously underestimates the Decepticons. But on the verge of defeat, Optimus reveals a new ability.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: On the moon, Thrust continues his plotting with Megatron. On earth, despite Jetfire saying he's one of the good guys, the kids are suspicious of Sideways - as are the Decepticons. And something huge and ominous is approaching earth.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: The massive Tidalwave joins the Decepticons, but is, seemingly, defeated in battle by Hot Shot and Blurr. Alexis discovers three new minicons, which Sideways says combine to create another ultimate weapon, the Requiem Blaster.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: The kids try to gather the three Requiem Blaster minicons together. Sky Blast at first resists, then sings the others to him to save Optimus. They all realise there's more to the minicons than first appears.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Understanding that the minicons want to be in charge of their own destinies, the kids sneak the new team out of the base. Thrust finds them, but so do the Autobots who save the day. It's agreed the minicons should not be forced to fight.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Enthusiastic young Sideswipe, Blurr's hero-worshipper, joins the team and Optimus tasks Hot Shot with training him. Wheeljack also arrives on earth, bent on revenge for Hot Shot seemingly abandoning him during a battle on Cybertron.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Desperate to make amends to his old friend, Hot Shot allows Wheeljack to shoot him, but this isn't enough. Wheeljack takes Sideswipe hostage, but Hot Shot rescues him. On the moon, Megatron welcomes Wheeljack to the Decepticons.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Megatron sacrifices Starscream, leaving him to face the Autobots alone while the Decepticons infiltrate the Autobot base to capture the Requiem Blaster. Smokescreen sacrifices himself to try to protect the Blaster minicons.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Hearing Megatron say he is nothing more than disposable cannon fodder, Starscream defects with the Star Sabre. To prove he's genuine, he gives the Autobots details of the moon base. Red Alert works on what's left of Smokescreen.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: With Starscream's help, the Autobots infiltrate the Decepticon moon base, attempting to rescue all the minicons Megatron has captured and forced into building a spaceship.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Alexis tracks a minicon in the vicinity of Mars. Starscream gets there first, but is disabled by Tidalwave. Jetfire rescues him: on the way back Starscream spots and tries to entice the minicon. But first they must get past Megatron.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: With the kids befriending and welcoming him, the Autobots deeply suspicious of him, and driven by his need to kill Megatron, the deeply conflicted Starscream trusts Thrust and returns to the moon base with the Star Sabre and Skyboom Shield.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Sabre, Shield and Blaster together create the Hydra Cannon. Installed on their new ship, the Decepticons test it on a comet - then Megatron orders Starscream to use it to destroy the Autobot base. Problem is, that'll also destroy the earth.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Optimus and Jetfire attack the ship, but can't stop the Hydra Cannon being deployed. Optimus makes the ultimate sacrifice and takes the full blast. Afterwards only his minicon and his matrix are found, but at least earth survives.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Hot Shot insists they should take vengeance on the Decepticons: Scavenger, with the support of the minicons, reminds him of their true purpose. With Hot Shot's realisation of the right way forward, Jetfire hands over command to him.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: With the Autobot ship ready to leave, Hot Shot, supported by the rest of the team, refuse to let the children accompany them. But then the minicons refuse to allow the ship to depart unless the kids are on board.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: As the Axalon chases the Decepticon ship, hundreds of minicons appear. The 'Cons turn back to fight, and the 'Bots seem doomed, but the minicons resurrect Optimus.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Hot Shot and Red Alert are sucked through a wormhole. The minicons guide the Axalon to their location, where they are all attacked by Nemesis Prime. As the planet breaks up, the 'Cons shoot down the Axalon and escape.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: The 'Bots reach Cybertron to find Megatron (now calling himself Galvatron) already winning the war. The minicons fend off an attack by Unicron, warning of great danger, but Galvatron believes it just an Autobot trick.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: While the battle continues, Hot Shot goes to Cybertron to try to convince Galvatron of the impending danger. Thrust's true allegiance and agenda is revealed.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Thrust flees into the depths of Cybertron, pursued by Hot Shot and Wheeljack - and, separately, Starscream, who saves the children from being killed. The children discover the origins of the minicons.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: Thrust joins Sideways by passing through a portal deep underground: his pursuers follow and find themselves on Cybertron's moon, which begins to disintegrate. To everyone's horror, Unicron is revealed.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: To convince Galvatron he must ally with Optimus to prevent Unicron taking over the universe, Starscream makes the ultimate sacrifice.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: With the Decepticons and Autobots allied, both armadas engage the planet-sized, transformed Unicron in battle in order to save Cybertron.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: The only way to defeat Unicron is to wake the minicons inside him and attack from within as well as without. Red Alert and the kids use the portal to travel to Unicron's core.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: With the minicons protecting Cybertron and Hot Shot's team attacking Unicron from outside, and Optimus and Galvatron facing Sideways at Unicron's heart, the purpose and meaning behind the endless war is revealed.

programme.title: Transformers: Armada
programme.desc: With Unicron seemingly defeated, Galvatron insists on settling things with Optimus, and the fight wakes Unicron again. Galvatron makes the ultimate sacrifice to finally end the threat. Jetfire and Hot Shot return the children to earth.

programme.title: Transformers: Cybertron

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: During a fight with Tong Fo, Po is struck by lightning, giving him the power to read minds.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Over Po's objections, Shifu calls in a noble Samurai prawn to help take down a villain from Japan.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Shifu suggests Po takes a vow of silence to help him focus, but his plan goes awry when the panda starts an armed conflict by keeping his mouth shut.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Once deemed a hero, cobra Fu-xi has turned renegade and is attacking the Valley of Peace. When the villagers adopt an anti-snake sentiment, will Viper help stop Fu-xi...or join him?

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: The local thugs love Mr. Ping's soup so much, the noodle shop becomes a villain hangout...with Mr. Ping as their unknowing crime boss!

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po befriends a group of young (and adorable) orphans-who also happen to be stealing money and goods from the villagers. Will Po be able to reform the kids or fall into the clutches of their evil leader?

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Fed up with his constant complaining, Shifu puts lazy Po in charge of training the Furious Five. Things go from bad to worse when the Croc Bandits receive training from a mysterious kung fu master and become the new heroes of the Valley of Peace.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po is named Head of Imperial Security when klutzy Lu Kang returns to the Valley of Peace as emperor. When an evil menace rises to take over all of China, Po has to turn to some surprising allies in order to save the day.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po is named Head of Imperial Security when klutzy Lu Kang returns to the Valley of Peace as emperor. When an evil menace rises to take over all of China, Po has to turn to some surprising allies in order to save the day.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: When Shifu sends Po to shut down an underground fight club, the panda disobeys his master and joins the club instead.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po and the Five have to stop a famine by bringing a maniacal gang of food-thieving rats to justice. But, will Po's weakness for food alienate himself from his friends and the very villagers he is trying to help

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po discovers the seeds of Shuyong: magical items that can actually take the user back in time. After Po disobeys Shifu, evil Fenghuang steals one of the seeds, putting the entire world in danger.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po's qi is out of balance. He and his friends attempt to re-harmonize the panda using the tradition of musical kung fu. They better work fast, as only Po can stop the destruction of the Eternal Chord and un-creating the universe.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po has to help Master Yao after Taotie and Bian Zao steal the Mystic Secrets of Kung Fu right out of the master's head.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Shifu's evil ex-girlfriend Mei Ling is back...and back together with Shifu! Dubious Po must find out if she is on the level or just using Shifu for her own criminal gain.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Po and Monkey discover a small village and meet an impostor claiming to be the Dragon Warrior. Po is determined to expose the fraud but could end up doing more harm than good.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: When Po throws a party and invites the First Furious Five to attend, everyone is shocked to learn that Shifu may not be the courageous hero that they thought he was.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: After Bian Zao steals magical lightning powers, he snubs his villain father Taotie and instead teams up with the vicious Tong Fo and the Croc Bandits. Will Po and Taotie knock some sense into Bian Zao before he uses his powers to destroy the village?

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: General Tsin is back with a crazy conspiracy theory about alien rice weevils trying to take over the world. When Po learns Tsin is telling the truth, it's up to the Kung Fu Panda to stop the invasion before it's too late.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: After Zeng unhappily quits his job at the Jade Palace, Po cheers up the weepy goose by telling him he could be a kung fu master. Bad idea, Po. Bad idea.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: With his childhood bully back in town, Po must learn to face his fear or risk losing his Dragon Warrior mojo and those that are most important to him.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: Tired of Po getting all the credit and acclaim, the Furious Five quit the Jade Palace and strike out on their own.

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: It's a battle between master and father when Shifu and Mr. Ping compete for Po's attention and affection during a camping trip. But will their competition get in the way of Po defeating the Valley's newest menace?

programme.title: Kung Fu Panda: Legends of Awesomeness
programme.desc: After a blow to the head leaves Po with amnesia, Fung and the Croc Bandits are more than happy to use it to their advantage...by convincing the Dragon Warrior that he is their evil bandit leader.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Gina says her daughter, Alexis, 18, was "kidnapped" and "held hostage" by her survivalist boyfriend, David, 19, which Alexis and David deny. Mom Gina fears for Alexis's safety. David agrees he’s a survivalist who owns guns, but he's not dangerous. Part 1
programme.sub-title: I'm Afraid My Daughter Was Kidnapped By Her Survivalist Boyfriend Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Ashley was sexually abused by her father from ages of 5 to 18, locked in a small camper, while giving birth to four of her father's children. In her first national interview since her father's arrest, the 22-year-old mom speaks about her horrible ordeal.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Keirsten claims her boyfriend, Mike, has slammed her face into the car radio and repeatedly hit her in the head, giving her several black eyes and a bloody lip. Although Mike's been arrested twice for domestic battery, she loves him and he's a great dad.
programme.sub-title: Daughter's Boyfriend Has Been Arrested For Domestic Battery Twice But She Refuses To Leave Him

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Jodie says since husband Edwin won $1.66 million in a lottery pool, he's angry, distant, secretive & the marriage is in trouble. Edwin says problems started way before his money win. The couple talks to Dr. Phil wondering if their marriage can be saved.
programme.sub-title: My Husband's Big Lottery Win Is Ruining Our Marriage

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Monica's old life: English teacher, marathon runner, happy. Now 90 lbs. and no solid food with a C-diff diagnosis, she chains herself to bed to avoid sleepwalking or binge eating. It's a full-time job for mom, Stephanie; friend Breanna suspects enabling.
programme.sub-title: Painfully Ill: Can Monica Be Saved?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tensions run high in this father/daughter battle conclusion. McKinley, 18, confronts her dad for allegedly being "abusive" in her childhood & a "pedophile," claims he denies. Dr. Phil questions Cory on an incident leading to Cory's sexual battery arrest.
programme.sub-title: An Abusive Father Or A Delusional Teen: Who Is Telling The Truth? Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Michelle thought she had a perfect marriage until Wade admitted to keeping a horrible secret from his wife. Little did she know this one revelation would be the tip of the iceberg. Dr. Phil continues the startling story of Wade and Michelle. Part 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tina says her sons lived in a “house of horrors” with their biological father, Jeff, and his wife, Sandra, with reports to Child Protective Services that “fell on deaf ears.” Son Ian and Christa, also from the home, tell of horrific abuse they endured.
programme.sub-title: Adopted Twin, Beaten, Strangled, Starved And Locked In A Room: The Exclusive Interview

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Brittany claims dad Charlie is scammed by his online fiancée "Stephanie" & her roommate "Carina." Charlie has given over $25K while "Stephanie" maintains a $4.5 million inheritance is coming. The investigation starts in Los Angeles and ends in Denmark!
programme.sub-title: Love Or Larceny: My Father's Fiance Is Fake Pt. 1

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Trust has been ranked as the #1 crucial quality for a happy marriage. Deanne & Brian have been married for 12 years with four children between them. Now, due to alleged lies and infidelity, their family is torn apart and divorce is just a signature away.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his work with a family ripped apart by accusations of child molestation. Father Jason agrees to take a polygraph test to prove his innocence. Tune in to find out the results and what's next for this family!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Tammy and Paul wed for eight years until their marriage ended. After nine months apart the couple secretly remarried, unbeknownst to their families, who would not approve. Weeks after saying "I do" a second time, the two are having doubts of their own.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Meet 15-year-old Marie who says she is now pregnant after running away three times. Dr. Phil confronts Marie about a prenatal regimen, her plan and ensuing drama over a pregnancy test request. Dr. Phil and the family discuss pregnancy test results. Part 2
programme.sub-title: Test Results Revealed: Is 15-Year-Old Marie Really Pregnant Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: After former friends Randi & Haley tell Brittany's history of harassing men & faking pregnancies, Dr. Phil talks to Brittany and asks her to prove she is pregnant. What sent Brittany storming off stage? See the backstage conversation with Dr. Phil.
programme.sub-title: Multiple Restraining Orders And Fake Births: Brittany Speaks Pt. 2

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Alisha says her son, Kevin, 10, pushed the family to the limit with violent outbursts. At home, knives and lighters are hidden & siblings lock themselves in their rooms at night. Alisha's says the 'future Kevin' may hurt the entire family or end a life.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Bob says his wife of 23 years, Dorothy, accuses him of cheating despite his denial. He says Dorothy has clawed his face, smashed windows & threatened to cut off his manhood, convinced he's been unfaithful. What does Bob say is the cause of her mistrust?
programme.sub-title: A Lying, Cheating, Violent Husband Or A Wife's False Accusations?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil investigates a popular new website that dishes the dirt on non-celebrities. On creator Nik Richie's controversial site, TheDirty.com, people anonymously submit photos & negative comments about anyone in their community, tabloid style.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: It's Ask Dr. Phil day. Is it an attractive woman's responsibility to tone down her looks on the job? Debrahlee made headlines saying she was fired for being too pretty. She says she was told her figure, pencil skirts & 3-inch heels were too distracting.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you constantly have to compromise to get along with your mate? Do you feel like you have to give up a vital part of yourself to be in a relationship? Dr. Phil talks to controlling guests, and the loved ones who feel trapped by them.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: When you imagine getting an inheritance, you might assume all your financial problems would be solved. But can the money be more trouble than it's worth?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Kalan says Giovanni made a major shift in his identity two days after he asked her to marry him. The army veteran changed his persona to superhero, wears a mask, and only answers to “Goose Wayne Batman.” Kalan won't walk down the aisle with a masked man.
